EcstatiKink 10.10
=================

By[HeartCore](#organizer-card)

Follow

[Location TBD](#location)

Saturday, October 10  •  7 PM - 11:30 PM

Overview

Ready to play?
EcstatiKink is landing in Berlin!
bringing a night where bodies speak louder than words, and curiosity is the main language..

NEW, IMPROVED & WORTH THE WAIT — WE’RE BACK!

ECSTATIKINK III

with Didi Porat & Tori Baba  
Special guest: KinoKo

🖤 Berlin · October 10 · 19:00–00:00 🖤  
Private venue in Pankow

Ready to play?
--------------

Expect fresh surprises, unexpected twists, and a night where bodies speak louder than words—and curiosity is our common language.

A space to move the way your body truly wants to move.  
To breathe the way your desire wants to breathe.  
To awaken the places within you that haven’t received attention in a long time—the light, the shadow, the sweet, the dirty, the soft, and the bold.

It’s ecstatic dance with a twist.  
A conscious kink exploration with a wink.  
A night that doesn’t ask you to behave—only to be real.

Bring your hunger.  
Bring your shyness.  
Bring your inner troublemaker.

All of them have a place here.

⸻

🌹 THE FLOW
----------

### Part I — EcstatiKink Flow

A guided sensual journey through rhythm, impulse, pleasure, and whatever truth your body wants to express.

You’ll warm up, melt, open, tease—and perhaps surprise yourself—all carried by the irresistible musical journey of our beloved kinky DJ's

### Part II — Free Flow

The Temple opens, and the night becomes deliciously wild—or beautifully slow. The choice is yours.

Flirt with energy.  
Follow someone’s gaze.  
Rest in a corner and allow yourself to be seen.  
Or simply watch the room unfold.

Connection, courage, consent, and pulsating aliveness.

⸻

WHAT TO EXPECT
--------------

EcstatiKink is an ecstatic dance experience: powerful music, a mostly sober space, and an invitation to drop fully into your body and authentic expression.

What makes it different is the guided facilitation and the playful exploration stations woven throughout the night.

For us, “kink” is anything that lives just beyond what feels normal or familiar to you. It doesn’t have to be sexual.

Throughout the event, you’ll be invited to explore new sensations, interactions, and forms of expression through movement, presence, touch, taste, and connection.

Playful, friendly, sensual—or simply curious.

Always consensual.  
Always optional.  
Every invitation can be met with a yes, a no, or a change of mind.

When you need a little pause, our snack table will be waiting—with delicious bites to help you recharge, ground, and return to the dance.

This is an inclusive space, warmly welcoming solo explorers, monogamous couples, open and polyamorous people, queer, gay, straight, and questioning guests—of all genders and sexual orientations.

Come as you are. Let curiosity lead the way.

⸻

💫 SCHEDULE
----------

19:00 — Arrival  
19:30 — Doors close  
20:00–22:00 — EcstatiKink Flow  
22:00–00:00 — Free Flow

Please arrive on time. Entry after the doors close may not be possible.

⸻

🎟 TICKETS
---------

Early Bird — €39  
Regular — €55  
Last Tickets — €66  
Golden Supporter — €99

Ceremonial cacao is included.

The private location will be shared with ticket holders a few days before the event.

If money is a concern, please reach out. We want everyone who genuinely feels the call to have the opportunity to join: tori@blissmusic.eu

Tickets are non-refundable, but you’re welcome to pass yours on or resell it. Please make sure the new ticket holder receives the scannable ticket.

⸻

✨ WHAT TO BRING
---------------

* Clothes that make you feel… edible
* A sarong or towel
* Water—you’ll need it 😉

This is a mostly sober space. The high comes from chemistry, breath, music, and play.

⸻

MEET THE HUMANS BEHIND THE MAGIC
--------------------------------

Didi Porat — [@didi.journeys](https://www.instagram.com/didi.journeys "https://www.instagram.com/didi.journeys")  
Tori Baba — [@tori\_baba](https://www.instagram.com/tori_baba "https://www.instagram.com/tori_baba")  
Special guest KinoKo — [@kinoko.music](https://www.instagram.com/kinoko.music "https://www.instagram.com/kinoko.music")  
EcstatiKink — [@ecstatikink](https://www.instagram.com/ecstatikink "https://www.instagram.com/ecstatikink")

### With loving support from

Tara · Sunny Ju · Kaya · Fey · Vishal · Dani · Alexandre · Liz · Ori · Max · Maria · Gaby · Ali · Farhad · Tal · Niene

⸻

If something in your body is already stirring, stay curious.

See you inside EcstatiKink. 🔥🖤

For us, “kink” is anything that lives just beyond what feels normal or familiar to you. It doesn’t have to be sexual.

Throughout the event, you’ll be invited to explore new sensations, interactions, and forms of expression through movement, presence, touch, taste, and connection.

Playful, friendly, sensual—or simply curious.

Every invitation can be met with a yes, a no, or a change of mind.

When you need a little pause, our snack table will be waiting—with delicious bites to help you recharge, ground, and return to the dance.

Emotional Detox Through Tantric-Tao Bodywork (Englisch)
-------------------------------------------------------

##### 31. Mai 2027 - 6. Juni 2027

### Veranstaltung Navigation

![](https://www.rosenwaldhof.de/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/Mallorca-schwarzweiss-Tina-und-Ich.png)

*English below…*

Emotionen und Traumata aus der Vergangenheit können tief in unserem Körpergedächtnis gespeichert sein und unser alltägliches Leben unbewusst prägen: wie wir denken, fühlen und (re)agieren und auch, wie wir Beziehungen gestalten.

In diesem Retreat lernst Du eine (bekleidete) Tantrisch-Taoistische Ganzkörpermassage kennen, mit der emotionale Wunden aus der Vergangenheit geheilt und tiefsitzende Blockaden gelöst werden können.

Du lernst, dass anhand von bestimmten Berührungs-, Energie- und Atemtechniken, (jahrelang) unterdrückte Gefühle an die Oberfläche kommen können, um verarbeitet und aufgelöst zu werden. Dadurch kann die eigene Lebensenergie ins Fließen gebracht werden, was uns mit mehr Leichtigkeit, Freude, Lebendigkeit und Liebe durchs Leben gehen lässt.

Das Retreat bietet Dir einen sicheren Raum, in dem Du tiefe Berührung erfahren und alle Gefühle zulassen darfst: von Traurigkeit, Wut, Misstrauen, Scham und Schuld, bis hin zu Lust, Glückseligkeit und Ekstase. Es ermöglicht eine intensive, transformative Erfahrung, die Dir dabei helfen kann, wieder auf einer tieferen Ebene mit Dir selbst verbunden zu sein – und dadurch auch mit Deinen Mitmenschen und dem großen Ganzen.

[![](https://www.rosenwaldhof.de/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Bild-1-2-1024x461.jpg)](https://www.rosenwaldhof.de/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Bild-1-2.jpg)  
**Für wen ist dieses Retreat  / Voraussetzungen**

Es ist für alle, die sich selbst auf einer tieferen Ebene begegnen wollen, um sich persönlich oder spirituell weiterzuentwickeln. Es kann als Grundlage für die Ausbildung zum Emotional Detox Therapist genutzt werden. Die Teilnahme ist als Single, Paar oder Einzelperson möglich (ab 21 Jahren). Es sind keinerlei Vorkenntnisse nötig.

**Veranstalter\*innen:**  
Das Retreat wird geleitet von Martina und Ricardo aus Deutschland sowie ihrem Lehrer und Supervisor Mal aus Sri Lanka, dem Gründer der Tantric Journey School of Healing and Awakening.

**Kosten**

zzgl. Kosten für Unterkunft und Bio-Vollverpflegung im Rosenwaldhof zwischen 460 € und 740 € (je nach Zimmerkategorie)

Bitte schreibe eine Email an r.roehmer@gmx.de, um den Rabattcode zu erhalten.

Bonus: Der Kurs kann kostenfrei wiederholt werden, sofern Plätze frei sind.

[![](https://www.rosenwaldhof.de/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/tempImageySlFPr-300x272.jpg)](https://www.rosenwaldhof.de/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/tempImageySlFPr.jpg)

An folgenden Terminen bieten wir eine kostenlose Einführung zu Tantric Journey mit anschließender Q&A-Session auf Zoom an:

12. Juli 2026, 20:30 Uhr  
09. Aug 2026, 20:30 Uhr  
25. Okt 2026, 20:30 Uhr

**English:**  
Emotions and traumas from the past can be stored in our body’s memory and unconsciously shape our daily lives: how we think, feel, and (re)act, as well as how we form relationships.

In this retreat, you will learn a (clothed) Tantric-Taoist full-body massage designed to heal emotional wounds from the past and dissolve deep-seated blockages. You will learn that through the art of certain touch, energy, and breathing techniques, feelings that have been suppressed (for years) can rise to the surface to be processed and resolved. This allows your natural life force to flow freely again, enabling you to navigate life with more ease, joy, vitality, and love.

The retreat offers you a safe space where you can experience profound touch and allow all feelings to surface: from sadness, anger, mistrust, shame, and guilt, to desire, bliss, and ecstasy. It facilitates an intense, transformative experience that can help you reconnect with yourself on a deeper level – and through that, with your fellow human beings and the greater whole.
